comment: Blood Sun step 1: GOLGARI ROT FARM ENTERS TAPPED (the Rakdos Carnarium shape: enters_tapped + etb_bounce_land). Swamp + Forest untapped; the Rot Farm is played FIRST (landat=0) so its bounce returns one basic, tapped for its mana in response (floating), leaving 2 mana. Cultivate {2}{G} needs 3: ILLEGAL. Had the Rot Farm entered untapped it would add {B}{G} (4 mana) and the line would be legal.
